crossRefs.note: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
Amaziah took courage, and led his people out, and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children…
The children of Judah carried away ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down…
David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of…
Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Salt_Valley
people.line: Valley where David and his commanders defeated enemies

people.name: Sela
people.line: Edomite stronghold captured by King Amaziah of Judah

translations.web: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.
translations.bsb: Amaziah struck down 10,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt. He took Sela in battle and called it Joktheel, which is its name to this very day.
translations.kjv: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.
translations.asv: He slew of Edom in the Valley of Salt ten thousand, and took Sela by war, and called the name of it Joktheel, unto this day.
